title: Facial Structure of Classical and Quantum Correlation Sets
exact_target: Describe the relevant faces of the local correlation polytope and determine whether quantum boundary correlations have minimal pure-state, rank-one measurement realizations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000178 (OWR-785-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Entanglement and Decoherence: Mathematics and Physics of Quantum Information and Computation (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/04, pp. 185--255; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 27--28, printed pages 211--212.
Collins et al., Bell inequalities for arbitrarily high-dimensional systems; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: Use the report's meaning of a quantum-violable Bell face; merely calling every supporting local inequality a Bell inequality would make the first question tautological. Minimal local dimensions, pure-state realizations, and rank-one projectors are bundled requirements. The report's historical treatment of Q must not be silently replaced by a modern closure or commuting-operator correlation set.
